permisive.description: Whether the daemon runs in permissive mode. 0=strict, 1=permissive.

nice_val.description: Nice value for the daemon process priority.

q_size.description: Size of the internal event queue.

uid.description: User ID to drop privileges to.

gid.description: Group ID to drop privileges to.

detailed_report.description: Whether to generate detailed access reports.

db_max_size.description: Maximum size (MB) of the database cache.

watch_fs.description: Comma-separated list of filesystems to watch.

rpm_sha256_only.description: If 1, only use SHA256 checksums for RPM packages.

allow_filesystem_mark.description: Whether to allow marking files via filesystem operations.

report_interval.description: Interval in seconds between periodic reports (0 = disabled).
